description: This Java source file defines the LogFragment class, which extends Android's Fragment class. It manages a user interface component that displays log messages within a scrollable view, utilizing a custom LogView component. The class handles creating views, configuring UI elements, and updating the scroll position when log content changes.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A fragment that contains a LogView for outputting log data received via the LogNode interface. It creates a scrollable, styled log view, manages view inflation, and updates the scroll position after text changes.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, sets styling and layout parameters, and returns the root view containing the log interface.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Overridden method that inflates the fragment's view hierarchy, adds a text change listener to auto-scroll to the bottom when new log messages are added.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Accessor for retrieving the LogView instance managed by this fragment.
